verdict.rationale: Dropbox supports the core building blocks for a lightweight data room: shared folders, view-only vs editor link permissions, password protection, and file restore windows (dropbox-docs-9, dropbox-docs-24, dropbox-docs-31, dropbox-docs-39, dropbox-docs-14/25). However, there is no evidence of dedicated 'access visibility' features like granular download-blocking, link expiration, or per-viewer audit logs typically associated with a true data-room product, and no diligence-specific packaging is documented. Missing for 10: explicit download-control toggles, link expiration/audit-trail visibility, and any first-party framing of Dropbox as a data-room/diligence tool.
